387.blurb: A hunting party found fresh water on this island in 1761, and a small fort town grew up there. In 1971 it joined its neighbours to form a new land and became its capital. A vast white grand mosque, built from stone and gold sent by lands around the world, shines in its sun. Abu Dhabi is the capital of the United Arab Emirates.

388.blurb: This coastal city became the capital of the British Gold Coast in 1877, and it kept the job when Ghana won its freedom. Its name grew from a word for ants, after the anthills round about it. Accra is the capital of Ghana.

389.blurb: King Menelik founded this city by the hot springs in 1886. Three years later it became the capital of his empire. Today it is a great hub of rule and talks for the whole continent, home to the African Union. Addis Ababa is the capital of Ethiopia.

390.blurb: Dutch traders built forts on the Hudson here in the 1600s, and the town won its charter in 1686. In 1797 it became the state capital for good, and lawmakers have met here since. Albany is the capital of New York.

391.blurb: Fishers built a small town by a dam on a river, and trade ships later made it rich and famous. Its canals and grand houses still show that golden age, and bikes fill its streets today. Amsterdam is the capital of the Netherlands.

392.blurb: Puritan settlers founded a small port on the bay here in 1649. In 1694 the royal governor moved the colony capital to this town and gave it a new name. George Washington gave up his army command in its State House in 1783, and sailboats crowd its harbor today. Annapolis is the capital of Maryland.

393.blurb: This town began more than 3,000 years ago and gave the world its first taste of rule by free votes. In 1834 it was picked as the capital of a free land, and a grand temple still crowns its rock. Today crowds climb to that temple and lawmakers meet in an old palace. Athens is the capital of Greece.

394.blurb: Atlanta began as the end stop of a state railroad, and its strong rail lines won it the state capital in 1868. Martin Luther King Jr. led the civil rights fight from here in the years that followed. Atlanta is the capital of Georgia.

395.blurb: In 1839, a site by the river was picked for a fresh capital, and the village first called Waterloo was laid out there. Today mother bats raise their pups under a bridge while lawmakers meet in the state capitol: the building is the capitol, and the city is the capital. Austin is the capital of Texas.

396.blurb: A small trading post grew here by the river long ago. In 1782 King Rama I moved the capital across the river and founded the city in earnest. Traders from far lands then helped it grow into a great port and royal city. Bangkok is the capital of Thailand.

397.blurb: This city has been a political centre for most of eight centuries, and in 1420 the Ming rulers made it their chief capital as their fresh palace was finished. Emperors lived and ruled from that palace, and today crowds visit its halls and yards. Beijing is the capital of China.

398.blurb: Traders founded this city by a river crossing in the 1200s, and kings and emperors later ruled from it. After a war a wall split it in two, until the halves joined again in 1990. Artists then painted the wall that still stands. Berlin is the capital of Germany.

399.blurb: Gold finds in 1863 brought a new fort and a rush of miners to this river valley. A court fight then made the young town the territory capital, and it kept the job at statehood. Boise is the capital of Idaho.

400.blurb: Puritan settlers founded Boston on a peninsula in 1630, and in 1773 its people dumped tea in the harbor to fight a tax. Today it stands as a great port and learning center on the Atlantic coast. Boston is the capital of Massachusetts.

401.blurb: Brazil kept its capital in Rio de Janeiro for nearly 200 years, but its leaders wanted a seat near the centre of the land. President Kubitschek had a whole fresh city built on the high plains, and it opened in 1960. Brasília is the capital of Brazil.

402.blurb: Roman soldiers built a town here, and kings later ruled from the hill town of Buda. In 1873 Buda and Pest joined across the river to form one city. Its hot springs and grand halls draw crowds today. Budapest is the capital of Hungary.

403.blurb: Spanish sailors first built a town here in 1536, but attacks drove them off, and a lasting town rose in 1580. The port grew rich on trade, and a king later made it the capital of a vast ruled land. Dockside bars gave the world the tango, and grand streets still draw crowds today. Buenos Aires is the capital of Argentina.

404.blurb: Rulers founded this city in 969 and made it the capital of their caliphate four years later. Its mosques earned it the name city of a thousand minarets, and its old bazaar still trades today. Cairo is the capital of Egypt.

405.blurb: Sydney and Melbourne both wanted to be the capital when the colonies joined in 1901, so leaders picked a compromise site inland. They founded a planned city there and named it in 1913, and today a lake and hills frame its streets. Canberra is the capital of Australia.

406.blurb: The railroad laid out this town in 1867 beside a fort built to guard the tracks. Two years later it was named the territory capital, and it has held the seat ever since. Cheyenne is the capital of Wyoming.

407.blurb: Lawmakers founded a brand new city at the meeting of two rivers in 1812 and made it their capital in 1816. It grew into the state's largest city, with a zoo known round the world. Columbus is the capital of Ohio.

408.blurb: Viking fishers settled on this shore long ago, and in about 1416 a king moved his seat here and made it the capital. Traders, palaces, and a famed mermaid statue shaped the city in the years since. Copenhagen is the capital of Denmark.

409.blurb: Gold seekers founded Denver where two streams meet in 1858, and a vote in 1881 made it the lasting state capital. One mile up, its capitol building serves the state: the building is the capitol, and the city is the capital. Denver is the capital of Colorado.

410.blurb: A fort rose where two rivers meet in 1843, and the young town took the capital job in 1857. It grew into the biggest city in the state, a hub for farms, banks, and the first big votes for president. Des Moines is the capital of Iowa.

411.blurb: Viking raiders built a strong base here in 841, and the town grew to be the island's main town by the 1100s. In 1922, after the land won its freedom, this city became the capital of the free state. Today guests at its great college library can see two pages of a hand painted book from about the year 800. Dublin is the capital of Ireland.

412.blurb: An emperor made this place his capital in 1010 and named it for a rising dragon. The capital later moved away, then came back, and in 1976 the city led a land made whole again. Its lakes and old citadel still draw crowds today. Hanoi is the capital of Vietnam.

413.blurb: Ships from Spain founded a port town here in 1519, drawn by the fine harbour, and by 1552 it was the island's capital. Walls and forts rose to guard it from pirate raids at sea. Today old 1950s cars still roll past the long Malecón sea wall. Havana is the capital of Cuba.

414.blurb: Four gold seekers found gold in Last Chance Gulch in 1864, and a rich camp grew up fast in the valley. The town became the territory capital in 1875, and voters chose in 1892 and 1894 to keep it that way. Helena is the capital of Montana.

415.blurb: A king of Sweden founded this trading town in 1550 to rival a port across the gulf. In 1812 an emperor moved the seat of rule here, and the town grew into a great city. Helsinki is the capital of Finland.

416.blurb: Kamehameha III moved his kingdom's capital to Honolulu in 1845, and kings built palaces and churches in the port town. Today Waikiki's hotels line the beach by the old harbor. Honolulu is the capital of Hawaii.

417.blurb: In 1816, the year its state was born, Congress set aside land in the center for a new seat of government. Builders laid out a planned town there in 1821, and the government moved in by 1825. Race cars now roar around its famed track each year. Indianapolis is the capital of Indiana.

418.blurb: Dutch traders seized a port town here in 1619 and rebuilt it as Batavia, their chief town in Asia. Freedom was read out here in 1945, and the city became the capital in 1950. It is now a vast, warm city of traffic and trade by the sea. Jakarta is the capital of Indonesia.

419.blurb: Gold seekers built a mining camp here in 1880. The camp took its name from prospector Joe Juneau the next year. In 1906 it became the seat of government, moved from Sitka. Juneau is the capital of Alaska.

420.blurb: People have lived in this valley since old, old times, and its kings ruled from this city. A Licchavi king founded it by joining two towns, and it grew as a royal capital. Today guests from all over the world pass through it on their way to the great peaks. Kathmandu is the capital of Nepal.

421.blurb: Traders settled here on the river long ago, on the road from the Vikings to the Greeks. The city grew as the capital of Rus, and St Sophia Cathedral from those days still stands today. Kyiv is the capital of Ukraine.

422.blurb: Spanish men under Pizarro founded this city in 1535 and named it City of the Kings. It became the capital of a vast Spanish realm, then kept the job when the land won its freedom. Today it is a huge desert city by the cold Pacific, mild all year. Lima is the capital of Peru.

423.blurb: Founded in 1856 as a salt marsh village, this town was picked as the new capital in 1867 and renamed for a slain president. Its tall tower was done in 1932; the building is the capitol, and the city is the capital. Lincoln is the capital of Nebraska.

424.blurb: Sea traders set up a post by this harbour about 3,000 years ago, and the town grew by its wide river. In 1255 it became the capital, and it has been the land's centre of rule ever since. Today its old trams still roll on six lines through the streets. Lisbon is the capital of Portugal.

425.blurb: This city was founded in 1821 as the territory capital, on a river bank marked by a famous stone ledge. In 1957, nine brave Black students walked into Central High here and changed the nation. Little Rock is the capital of Arkansas.

426.blurb: Roman traders founded a town by the river here near the year 47, and it grew into a great port. In time the king's government settled here for good, and red buses and black taxis now fill its streets. London is the capital of the United Kingdom.

427.blurb: A judge bought swamp and woods here in 1829 and dreamed up a city on the strip between two lakes. Gifts of buffalo robes and cheap lots from that founder won it the capital in 1836. The domed building is the capitol, and the city is the capital. Madison is the capital of Wisconsin.

428.blurb: A walled fort rose by the river here in the 800s, guarding a border land. In 1561 the king set his court here for good, and the town grew into a great city. Its bear and tree statue still greets crowds in the old centre. Madrid is the capital of Spain.

429.blurb: A fort town stood here long ago, by the bay. In 1571 Spanish men took the shore, built a walled town, and made it the capital of their east isles. Ships from here once crossed the Pacific to link Asia with the Americas. Manila is the capital of the Philippines.

430.blurb: Mexica builders founded Tenochtitlan on a lake island in 1325, and Spanish rulers later razed it and rebuilt their own capital on the same ground. The lake is gone, but the main square still marks the old ceremonial heart. Mexico City is the capital of Mexico.

431.blurb: This city was first written about in 1147 and grew into the heart of a united land, until the capital moved away in 1712. In 1918 the capital came back, and the old fortress became the seat of power once more. Moscow is the capital of Russia.

432.blurb: Founded in 1779 as a river port, Nashville was named the lasting state capital in 1843. Today its country songs earn it the name Music City around the world. The building is the capitol; the city is the capital. Nashville is the capital of Tennessee.

433.blurb: For a long time Calcutta was the capital, until the rulers chose a fresh seat in 1911 and built it south of old Delhi. Architects planned wide roads and grand halls, and the seat opened in 1931. New Delhi is the capital of India.

434.blurb: This townsite on the inlet was claimed in 1846, and in 1853 it was declared the territory capital. It has stayed the capital through statehood and two big quakes that shook its old streets. Olympia is the capital of Washington.

435.blurb: Workers built a lumber town here in 1826, by a new canal that linked rivers and lakes. In 1857 a queen chose it as the capital, and parliament soon met on the hill. Boats still climb its old canal locks today. Ottawa is the capital of Canada.

436.blurb: River traders built a town on an island here more than 2,000 years ago, and in 508 King Clovis made it his capital. Kings, artists, and crowds at a great fair shaped the streets you see today. That iron tower from 1889 still stands over the city. Paris is the capital of France.

437.blurb: Settlers farmed by the Salt and Gila rivers here in 1867, using canals first dug long before them. The town became territorial capital in 1889 and a state capital in 1912. Phoenix is the capital of Arizona.

438.blurb: Dukes and kings of Bohemia held their seat here in old times, and Charles the Fourth later made the city an imperial capital. Its castle, old square, and famed stone bridge draw crowds from all over the world today. Prague is the capital of Czechia.

439.blurb: A trek leader founded this city in 1855 and made it the capital of his republic. The land now shares the capital job three ways: this city runs the government, while two other cities hold the laws and the courts. Thousands of jacaranda trees line its streets and parks. Pretoria is the capital of South Africa.

440.blurb: Leaders picked a fresh site near the middle of the state in 1788 and built a planned town there. They named it for Sir Walter Raleigh, the man behind the lost Roanoke Colony. Oak trees line its streets today, and research labs fill its edge. Raleigh is the capital of North Carolina.

441.blurb: Norse settlers reached this bay in the year 874 and farmed here for ages. The town was founded as a trading town in 1786, and the nation's assembly moved here in 1845. Today it is a clean, bright port, famed for its long summer days. Reykjavík is the capital of Iceland.

442.blurb: Traders and boatmen built a town by the river falls here in 1737. In 1775 Patrick Henry cried, give me liberty or give me death, in its church. Five years later it became the state capital, and lawmakers still meet here today. Richmond is the capital of Virginia.

443.blurb: Old tales say a she-wolf raised the twin boys who founded this city in 753 BC, and it grew to rule a vast empire. Its huge stone arena, old ruins, and seven hills still draw crowds from all over the world. Rome is the capital of Italy.

444.blurb: Gold seekers flooded this river town after gold was found near by in 1848, and in 1854 it became the state capital for good. Its state capitol was finished in 1874: the building is the capitol, and the city is the capital. Sacramento is the capital of California.

445.blurb: River traders and Dakota towns came first, and in 1849 a new territory made this river town its capital. Steamboats crowded its landing, and in 1905 a grand marble capitol rose on the hill. Mind the words: the building is the capitol, and the city is the capital. Saint Paul is the capital of Minnesota.

446.blurb: Mission settlers founded this valley town in 1842, and it became the capital of the territory in 1851. Two state houses here burned down; the building is the capitol, topped by a gold pioneer statue. Farms and cherry trees fill the green valley around it today. The city is the capital of the state: Salem is the capital of Oregon.

447.blurb: Pioneers led by Brigham Young founded Salt Lake City in 1847 beside the Great Salt Lake and dug canals to water the dry valley. It replaced Fillmore as territorial capital in 1856 and grew into the state's main city. Salt Lake City is the capital of Utah.

448.blurb: A Spanish governor founded Santa Fe in 1610 and made it his province's capital, the oldest state capital in the land. Adobe streets and the old Palace of the Governors still mark its plaza today. Santa Fe is the capital of New Mexico.

449.blurb: Pedro de Valdivia founded this city in 1541 as the seat of his new realm, with a grid of streets round a main square. Quakes and floods hit it hard over the years, yet it grew into a vast city under the high Andes. Santiago is the capital of Chile.

450.blurb: People of the Baekje kingdom first founded a town here long ago. In 1394 a new dynasty planned it as the capital, with palaces and a great wall. War later left it in ruins, but it rebuilt fast and hosted the Olympics in 1988. Seoul is the capital of South Korea.

451.blurb: Sailors traded at this island port long ago, when it was a sea town of kings. In 1819 a British man set up a trading post here, and in 1965 the island stood free as its own land. Its port and banks now rank with the best in the world. Singapore is the capital of Singapore.

452.blurb: Settlers built the first cabin here in 1820, by a creek full of deer and game. Abraham Lincoln moved here in 1837, worked as a lawyer, and helped win it the capital in 1839. His old home and tomb still draw crowds today. Springfield is the capital of Illinois.

453.blurb: A statesman founded this city in 1252 to shield the land from sea raids. In 1634 it became the official capital of the empire, and ships and iron made it rich. Today its islands hold palaces, prizes, and busy tech firms. Stockholm is the capital of Sweden.

454.blurb: Edo was a small fishing village until the Tokugawa rulers made it their seat in 1603, and in 1868 the emperor moved his capital here and gave it a fresh name. Its old castle became the Imperial Palace, and the city grew into a vast port of trains and towers. Tokyo is the capital of Japan.

455.blurb: Roman soldiers built a camp called Vindobona by the river in the first century. In 1804 the city became the capital of a new empire, and great composers made it a home of music. Palaces and grand halls still line its old streets today. Vienna is the capital of Austria.

456.blurb: A small fishing town stood here first, by the river. In 1596 a king moved his court here and made it the capital. War smashed the old town in the 1940s, and its people built it back stone by stone. Warsaw is the capital of Poland.

457.blurb: Leaders chose a fresh home for their young government by the Potomac in 1790, and a designer planned its streets from scratch. Congress moved here in 1800, and the White House became the home of the president. Washington is the capital of the United States.

458.blurb: Settlers built a town by this harbour in 1840, on land where Māori tribes had lived for ages. In 1865 the capital moved here from Auckland, and law makers have sat here since. Today a cable car climbs from the main streets to the hill suburbs over the harbour. Wellington is the capital of New Zealand.
